julia_surface_status: GLLVM.jl has no public isdm_sources()/isdm_source() surface yet (Design 120 / #941 is unported). Every case in this batch is bound only to the frozen R admission-predicate replay -- none is a public native/formula/bridge Julia fit. The Julia surface is tracked as a separate unpaid obligation, not a defect in these 20 specs (all 20 are evidence_kind=control by design).

health_checks.source_freshness: all three source_pins sha256 match the source root at run time
health_checks.fixture_freshness: fixture sha256 matches at run time
health_checks.isolation: each case expression is evaluated in a fresh environment chained only to the loaded function/constant environment, so no case can leak state into a later case
health_checks.contract_freshness: contract sha256 recorded in the receipt for tamper detection
health_checks.reference_commit_pin: receipt.reference_commit must equal this contract's reference_commit

cases.rationale: QR-rank retention: an aliased source-observation column is dropped and the retained ecological columns are byte-identical (values + dimnames) to the pre-augmentation design. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

Reordering the declared-source list to match data factor levels preserves the per-source observation formula attribute and keeps the reordered list admitted. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

An all-Poisson two-source declaration constructs (both laws admitted individually) but is NOT admitted into the mixed iSDM contract, because admission requires a mixed count+detection declaration; an all-count fit takes the ordinary ISDM-ZERO-ORDINARY route instead. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

A data row labelled with a source name not present in the declaration refuses admission. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

The pre-Design-120 gbif/survey_pa two-source family-list shape (family_var=isdm_family) is admitted through the same .gllvmTMB_isdm_declared_core() as the general isdm_sources() declaration, confirming Route 2 is the n=2 legacy instance of Route 1, not a separate contract. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

Admission depends only on source/trait/id structure, not response values: masking an entire arm's response to NA (as under response='include') does not change the admission verdict. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

Each generated isdm_source:<name>:<term> observation column is identically zero on every row outside that declared source, and the ecological design block is passed through unchanged. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

Removing one declared source's rows from just one trait (leaving that source present overall) refuses admission: every trait must carry every declared source. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

Dropping an entire declared source's rows from the data refuses admission. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

The baseline well-formed mixed two-arm declaration against its matching fixture data is admitted; the positive control every other ISDM-* negative case is a one-field mutation of. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

An iSDM fit with no offset() term in the formula is not refused: the offset is optional and defaults to a zero vector, independent of the cloglog change-of-support exemption. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

A NULL trait_labels argument (e.g. a caller that never resolved the trait vector) refuses admission rather than erroring or vacuously passing. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

The change-of-support offset for an iSDM fit is the ordinary offset() evaluation path: offset(log_support) round-trips to the log_support column, no special-cased arithmetic. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

The declared-core admission predicate generalises past the historical n=2 gbif/survey shape: a 3-source declaration (two Poisson arms, one cloglog arm) with matching fixture data is admitted. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

Removing a single row (leaving unequal row counts per source/trait, but every source still present in every trait) still admits: the predicate checks presence, not balance, by design (documented limit in isdm-sources.R). Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

With allow_isdm_mixed=TRUE, a within-trait family/link mixture (Poisson-log + Bernoulli-cloglog on the same trait) that would otherwise be refused by the one-family-per-trait rule passes -- the single sanctioned exception to that rule. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

isdm_source() itself performs no admitted-law check (binomial("logit") is accepted by the wrapper); the law gate is enforced only when isdm_sources() collects the declarations. Confirms the two-stage validation split (wrapper vs collector). Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

A row whose realised family id disagrees with the declared source's family id refuses admission, even though the source-label structure is otherwise consistent. Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

A row whose realised link id disagrees with the declared source's link id refuses admission (the link-id counterpart of ISDM-WRONG-ID). Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

An explicit offset(0) on a non-admitted (ordinary, non-mixed) fit evaluates through the same zero-offset path with no cloglog exemption needed -- the all-count declaration case that fits through the ordinary route (isdm-sources.R lines ~143-158). Admission-predicate behaviour is already pinned and control-verified against frozen R source; the remaining obligation is a public native/formula/bridge Julia surface once isdm_sources()/isdm_source() is ported, tracked separately (see docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-evidence.json unpaid list).

It does not establish any Julia native/formula/bridge fit, any recovery evidence, or admission behaviour for the 17 non-manifest cases in the wider 37-case docs/dev-log/core070/isdm-admission-subset.json.
julia_surface_status_p1_note: julia_surface_status is carried verbatim from P0. At the commit this twin was generated on, GLLVModels' src/ has no iSDM code (no isdm_sources, isdm_source or integrated-source fitter; the receipt tool records a git grep of src/ at the run commit). Draft PRs #546 (isdm_sources/isdm_source, isdm_table, fit_isdm_gllvm, predict) and #558 (unique = TRUE) build that surface on another branch, and #546's test/parity/isdm_cases.jl runs 19 of these 20 predicates natively in Julia against an R replay at P1 (ISDM-LEGACY is R-only by decision D-296). Whether those twins should pay these rows is a maintainer decision; this batch re-measures the R side only, as at P0.
